title: Integrative brain transcriptome analysis links complement component 4 and HSPA2 to the APOE ε2 protective effect in Alzheimer disease

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a completed primary analysis of human brain data in Alzheimer disease, but it does not analyze or explicitly frame an aging process or construct.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: APOE ε2/ε3 carrier status in Alzheimer disease cases and controls
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Differential C4A/C4B expression; associations with phosphorylated tau/total Tau ratio
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Differential gene expression between ε2/ε3 AD cases and controls

evidence_spans.quote: We analyzed gene expression data derived from autopsied brains donated by 982 individuals
differentially expressed genes between ɛ2/ɛ3 AD cases and controls

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed observational transcriptomic and co-expression analyses, without an applied qualifying causal or perturbation design.
